sources.citation: Hamm, Cameron. 2002 [issued 2003]. Sociolinguistic survey of the Kabalay language of Chad. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2003-008. Dallas: SIL International. 30 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey (intelligibility with Nancere, vitality, attitudes) plus a 225-item Kabalay/Nancere wordlist (Appendix D) with no transcription notes. Sec. 3.2 (p.7): 'The Kabalay language.. is little documented'; the only prior linguistic work named is Waingue B. Martin, 'Lexique kabalay' (1995, unpublished, SIL library N'Djamena). References list contains no phonology of Kabalai.
